description: This file contains a shell script that automates tests for Git's behavior regarding reading trees with confusing or suspicious paths. It sets up test environments, defines test cases, and verifies how Git rejects or accepts certain path patterns during tree reading operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executing the provided commands and verifying success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used to verify rejection of invalid operations.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test completes, for cleanup or setup purposes.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets Git configuration parameters for the duration of the test.
